title: EASY ARMS
subtitle: FRIDAY. SEATED AND WALL. LIGHT AND KIND.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is easy arms. Seated work and a bit on the wall. About ten minutes. If a joint is grumpy today, take a smaller range and we'll keep it kind.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Steady and comfortable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. You can sit a moment if you need. See you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Elbows back. Soft squeeze of the shoulder blades. Easy return. Light weights or empty hands.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row. Two sets of eight. Sit tall, elbows back, soft squeeze, then ease forward. Light weights are fine, or empty hands.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Light hand weights. Press up without locking hard. Stop short of pain. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press. Two sets of six. Light weights. Press up, soft elbows, stop short of anything sore.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five. Roll the shoulders gently.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall, feet back a little. Straight body. Chest toward the wall and press away. Standing only.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push-ups. Two sets of six. Hands on the wall, body straight, chest in and press away. Stay on your feet.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall. Lift one knee, lower with control. Alternate. Soft on the joints.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts. Two sets of eight each side. Sit tall, lift one knee, lower with control. Soft and steady.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. That's the session.
